bibliographic.title: Leda and the Swan
bibliographic.author: Lapin Lunaire Games
bibliographic.description:
"Leda and the Swan" is a kinetic prose poem whose heartbeat echoes the Greek myth.
It is intended for a mature audience and contains discussion of sexual assault, pregnancy/childbirth, and mild body horror/blood. Please engage with discretion and care for yourself. Thank you.
For the best experience, please play in fullscreen mode (click the button at bottom right of the frame or press Fn + F11).

For more about the developer and my other & ongoing projects, please visit my itch.io page or game development blog.
